name: Tanks, Pressure Vessels, Silos, Heat Exchangers & Boilers

work_packages.note: Tank ringwall/pad settlement survey; vessel saddle/skirt embeds; bund and drainage for storage
Shop-fabricated vessels set whole; large tanks field-erected shell-course by course (or jacked)
Shell/seam welding, welder qualification, RT/UT/PT/MT per code
Trays, demisters, distributors, heating coils, agitator mounts
After successful pressure/leak test; interface with painting/insulation
Process/relief piping, level/pressure/temperature instruments, cathodic protection

activities: Accept ringwall/pad/saddle foundation and settlement datum
Confirm embeds, anchor bolts, skirt bolt circle
Bund, liner and drainage complete for storage tanks
Set and grout saddle/skirt soleplates
sequence.note: Tanks need a settlement-monitoring datum before filling; saddles allow for thermal movement (one fixed, one sliding)

activities: Set shop-built vessel on saddles/skirt, or begin field erection
Field-erect tank: bottom plate, shell courses, roof (conventional or jack-up)
Fit and weld nozzles, manways, attachments
sequence.note: Orientation of nozzles/manways verified against GA before final welding

activities: Verticality/plumb and roundness check
Grout skirt/saddle base after level set
Final anchor torque
sequence.note: Verticality tolerance matters for columns and agitated vessels

activities: Install internals (trays, coils, distributors, demisters)
Connect process, relief and drain piping to nozzles
Fit relief valve(s) / PSV with test certificate
Support piping independently to avoid nozzle load
sequence.note: Internals installed and inspected (box-up) before final closure; PSV is the safety gate for pressurised equipment

activities: Land level, pressure, temperature and interlock instruments
Bond to earth; install/energise cathodic protection where specified
Terminate any heating (steam/electric) and agitator drive
Final NDE review and weld-map sign-off
Internal cleanliness / box-up inspection
Mechanical completion and dossier (U-stamp / code records)
sequence.note: Code dossier (e.g. vessel data report) is a commissioning gate

activities: Hydrostatic test of tank (with settlement survey during fill) or vessel
Pneumatic/leak test where hydro not permitted
PSV pop-test and set-pressure certificate
Vacuum/roof-vent test for tanks as applicable
sequence.note: Tank hydrotest doubles as a settlement/foundation proof; PSV must be certified before pressurising in service

activities: Drain, dry and clean after hydrotest
Apply insulation/fireproofing/coating (post-test)
Purge/inert vessels for hydrocarbon or oxygen-sensitive service
Calibrate level/pressure instruments in situ
sequence.note: Insulation only after a successful pressure test — you cannot inspect a leaking weld through insulation

activities: Fill/charge with process fluid
Bring to operating pressure/temperature
Prove relief, level and interlock functions live

typical_relationships.reason: Welds must be examined and accepted before the vessel is pressure-tested or closed
Pressure testing an unexamined weld risks a rupture; NDE is the prerequisite
Insulating before a successful test hides weld leaks and forces removal to re-inspect
Trays, coils and distributors must be installed and inspected before the vessel is closed and tested

typical_relationships.after: Bringing the vessel to operating pressure in service
typical_relationships.reason: A pressurised vessel without a certified relief device is an over-pressure hazard

typical_relationships.before: Ringwall/pad foundation and settlement datum accepted
typical_relationships.reason: Uneven or unsettled foundation distorts the shell and can fail the tank during fill
Residual test water must be removed and the vessel dried/inerted before hydrocarbon or reactive service

typical_relationships.before: Saddle/skirt grouted with sliding support free
typical_relationships.reason: Thermal growth must be free at the sliding saddle or the vessel and nozzles overstress

interfaces.requirement: Erection/setting REQUIRES ringwall/pad/saddle foundation accepted with a settlement datum and correct embeds/bolt circle
Service pressurising REQUIRES relief and process piping connected, and the PSV installed and certified
Insulation/coating REQUIRES a passed pressure/leak test first
Commissioning REQUIRES level/pressure/temperature instruments installed, calibrated and looped
Storage of flammables REQUIRES earthing/bonding (and cathodic protection where specified) complete
Hydrotest REQUIRES a test-water source and a permitted disposal/discharge route
Tank-farm handover REQUIRES foam/deluge and bund fire protection ready for flammable storage

testing_requirements: Hydrostatic test of tank/vessel to test pressure with hold
Tank foundation settlement survey during and after hydro-fill
Pneumatic/leak test where hydro is not permitted, with safety exclusion
Vacuum/roof-vent function test for storage tanks
Post-test drain, dry and internal cleanliness verification
commissioning_dependencies: NDE and pressure test passed and dossier complete
PSV and relief devices installed and certified
Internals installed and box-up inspection signed
Vessel drained, dried and purged/inerted for its service
Foundation settlement within limits after hydrotest
typical_exceptions: Atmospheric storage tanks are water-tested, not pressure-tested, and use vacuum/pressure vents rather than a PSV
Small shop-fabricated vessels arrive fully tested and stamped — field work is setting, piping and instrument tie-in only
Silos/bins for dry bulk are structurally/leak checked, not hydrotested
Plate heat exchangers are gasket/torque and pressure checked, not welded/NDE'd in the field
evidence: The vessel was insulated and coated before its hydrostatic test passed, and was brought toward operating pressure before the relief valve was pop-tested and certified.
